questions.q: What is the main role of the World Trade Organization (WTO)?
options: lending money to countries in financial trouble
setting rules for international trade and settling trade disputes
questions.why: The WTO regulates trade rules; lending is the IMF's role.

questions.q: Money sent home by migrants to their families is called...
questions.why: Remittances are a major income for many source countries.

questions.q: Which is a push factor for migration?
questions.why: Push factors make people leave the place they live; the others are pull factors.

questions.q: Explain one benefit and one cost of a TNC setting up a factory in a developing country.
questions.model: Benefit: provides jobs and wages, which raises incomes and creates a multiplier effect. Cost: much of the profit is sent back to the home country and low pay or poor conditions are possible.
